## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** Using full 16-month OPRA cache (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) for Stage-1. OOS walk-forward held-out window = last 4 months (2026-03-02 to 2026-06-18). Overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward and real-fills validation on anchor days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will perform after Stage-1 backtest)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will validate on top 3 J days after Stage-1 and OOS)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: max loss per trade during drawdown period (to be measured)
   - Max drawdown: peak-to-valley P&L decline (to be measured)
   - Blow-up scenario: repeated whipsaw in choppy markets causing consecutive stops (VIX < 15 + low volume)
6. **Concentration:** Will disclose top-5 days % of P&L after backtest (if top-5 > 200%, consider rework)
